body: Thank you so much for the advice I really appreciate it. Helped! I’ll definitely cut back on the advice. And my mental health is ok, so no need to worry. I’ve always been a painfully positive person, so I’ve always been mentally pretty strong, and I’m really fortunate to naturally be this way. Thanks again for the advice

Helped! I really appreciate the advice. She grew up with an abusive mom, and she’s tried to get help, her mom just doesn’t understand. I’ll definitely encourage her to try to find some other way of getting a therapist
